routing_policy.name: fastpath-then-realtime-with-text-veto
routing_policy.evidence_stage: full corpus 160 rows x 3 reps (cascade latencies/accuracy composed offline from measured paired runs)

steps.on_hit: execute tool args directly (no model call)

steps.endpointing: manual commit at client-detected end of speech (server_vad500 measured equal accuracy, +~0.6 s p50)

steps.rule: if the text model returns a schema-valid clarification, REPLACE the realtime answer with that clarification (never executes); otherwise keep the realtime answer
steps.why: adversarial correctness: realtime alone 72%, gemini text alone 94%, veto composite 97%, with 0 unsafe executions in 480 calls

tier_guardrails.emergency: fast path only when exactly one of force_retreat/cancel_attacks/hold/evacuate is unambiguous; negation or any army verb => abstain; NEVER use the shipped regex output {force_retreat,cancel_attacks} for single-flag requests (measured 0/12 correct flag sets)
tier_guardrails.operation: weakest tier (82%): UI MUST show the parsed operations (count, units, route, target) as 'pending/parsed' and allow cancel; do not present as confirmed
tier_guardrails.adversarial: any clarification/refusal answer must never reach /api/micromachine/modulate

routing_policy.backend_tolerance: accept command_layer='clarification' emitted by models when a clarification block is present (6/480 realtime calls did so; strict enum rejects them)
routing_policy.selection_rule: eligible: unsafe<=2% and error<=5% and p95<=tier budget (emergency 3s, micro 5s, others 8s); best=max exact-semantic accuracy; tie band 2pp; pick min p95
caveats: text-based steps were scored on GOLD transcripts (+1.59 s measured ASR p50 added to their latency); real ASR errors lower their accuracy (gemini fewshot 0.87 -> 0.76 on 3x40 screen with recorded ASR text)
corpus is synthetic TTS speech, author-written, 160 rows; ext_rules was written by the corpus author so its coverage/precision is optimistic
latencies measured on a loaded shared machine and shared proxy; use for ranking, not as absolute SLOs
